SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL
WHERE p.delete_at IS NULL AND ( u.account_vis = 'PUBLIC' OR p.user_id = #{viewerId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_user_id = #{viewerId} AND f.following_user_id = p.user_id ) )

SELECT p.post_id, u.user_id, u.username, u.profile_img AS profile_image_url, p.caption, p.translated_caption, p.created_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS comment_count,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked_byme,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM saves s WHERE s.post_id = p.post_id AND s.user_id = #{viewerId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS saved_byme,
CASE WHEN p.user_id = #{viewerId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL
WHERE p.delete_at IS NULL AND ( u.account_vis = 'PUBLIC' OR p.user_id = #{viewerId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_user_id = #{viewerId} AND f.following_user_id = p.user_id ) )
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT post_id, user_id, caption, translated_caption FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_at IS NULL

SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id AS author_user_id, u.username AS author_username, u.profile_img AS author_profile_image_url, u.account_vis AS author_account_vis, p.caption, p.translated_caption, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.delete_at IS NULL AND u.delete_at IS NULL
